usedFor: Eventzilla holds registrations and check-ins, and Sangam CRM records each attendee as a lead through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each registrant becomes a lead, and the action matches an existing lead by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Registration Is Updated” is separate from “New Registration”, so booking edits do not reach Sangam CRM unless added.
